test_cases.scenario: Log in with valid registered credentials
preconditions: User account user@example.com exists and is active
steps: Enter the email and password from test data
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to /dashboard and their name is shown in the header

test_cases.scenario: Log in with a wrong password
preconditions: User account user@example.com exists and is active
steps: Enter the email and the wrong password
test_cases.expected_result: Error 'Invalid email or password' is displayed and the user stays on the login page

test_cases.scenario: Account locks on the 5th consecutive failed attempt
preconditions: User account user@example.com exists with 0 failed attempts
steps: Confirm login is still allowed by checking no lock message is shown
Submit a wrong password a 5th time
test_cases.expected_result: After the 5th failure the account is locked and the correct password is rejected with the lock message
